_README: EVE Voice config. 1:1 RULE: each word or phrase you SAY triggers exactly ONE input - one key / one hotkey chord ("q", "alt+f1") OR one single mouse click ({"mouse": "left"|"right"|"middle"}). Never both, never a sequence. Combos ('steps'), double clicks and modifier+click are rejected when loading. Keys are EVE's DEFAULT shortcuts as best we know them, plus your spec (warp = D) - verify every one in-game (Esc > Shortcuts) and edit to match YOUR binds. Delete any group or line you don't use. Keys starting with '_' are comments.

settings._mode: How listening is triggered. "always" = every recognised phrase fires. "push_to_talk" = only while push_to_talk_key is held. "wake_word" = say the wake word first (e.g. 'computer warp', or 'computer' ... then 'warp' within wake_window_seconds).
settings._mic_device: null = Windows default mic. Run 'run.bat --list-devices' and put the number or part of the name here, e.g. 3 or "Blue Yeti".
settings._push_to_talk_key: Used when mode is push_to_talk. Hold this key while speaking, e.g. "scroll lock", "f13", "right alt". Keyboard keys only (no mouse buttons). Pick a key EVE does NOT use.
settings._wake_word: Used when mode is wake_word. A single distinctive word works best.
settings._wake_window_seconds: After saying the wake word on its own, you have this many seconds to say ONE command. The window closes after one command fires.
settings._require_eve_focus: If true, keys are only sent when the foreground window title contains window_title_contains.
settings._tts_confirm: Speak the command name back after sending (needs pyttsx3). print_confirm prints it in the console.
settings._cooldown_seconds: Ignore the SAME phrase if repeated within this many seconds (stops accidental double-fires). It only ever drops input, never adds any.
settings._key_hold_seconds: How long ONE key press is held down (keyDown..keyUp). It's part of that single press, not a delay between actions. Raise to 0.08-0.1 if EVE misses presses. Max 0.5.
settings._allow_mouse_at: Master switch for clicking SAVED screen spots (mouse_spot / mouse_box / mouse_at). Each is still ONE click at a location. 'run.bat --calibrate' turns this on when you save a spot. Saved spots are FRAGILE: re-run --calibrate if the EVE window, resolution, UI scale or panels move.
settings._model_path: Speech model folder. "model" = fast small model (setup.bat). "model-accurate" = the larger, more accurate English model (download it in the app: Settings > Speech accuracy).
settings._min_confidence: How sure the recogniser must be (0-1, lowest word) before acting. Below this it logs 'heard X (52%) - not sure, skipped' and sends nothing. 0.55 comes from tests with your recording: clean speech scores 1.0, correct words in heavy noise ~0.6. Raise it if you get wrong commands, lower it if it skips things you said clearly.
settings._noise_gate: Ignore audio quieter than this peak level (0-1, 0 = off). 0.04 sits just above the background level in your recording (0.01-0.03). Use 'Measure noise' in the app (Settings) to set it from your room/game sound.
settings._endpoint_silence_seconds: Act this long after you stop talking (shorter = snappier; too short can cut 'keep at range' in half). 0 = recogniser default.
settings._log_unmatched: Show lines for things it heard that weren't commands (with the closest command).
settings._fast_response: Act on a command as soon as it's fully heard, before you finish the sentence (faster). Several commands in one breath ('warp gate') fire one by one in the order you said them - each is still its own ONE input.
settings._allow_screen_read: OPT-IN, OFF by default. Lets 'gate' look at your calibrated Overview box (only that box, only at the moment you say it) to find the yellow next-gate row, then click it ONCE. Gray area - ask CCP support before relying on it.
settings._notes_updates: auto_update: check for a new signed release when the app starts (applied before the app opens; your commands.json, spots, models and venv are never touched). update_source: where releases live ({"type": "github", "repo": "WeBeAscended/eve-voice"}); update_url: static folder fallback used if the GitHub Releases API fails or is rate-limited (null = the built-in default, raw.githubusercontent.com/WeBeAscended/eve-voice/main/release/).

target._note: EXPERIMENTAL - leave mode as "foreground" unless you know you want this. "foreground" = send ONE input to the active window (only if its title contains window_title_contains). "background_window" = send ONE posted key/click to the ONE window whose title EXACTLY matches window_title (e.g. "EVE - Character Name"; see 'run.bat --list-windows'), without focusing it or moving your mouse. In that mode only single keys and saved-spot clicks work (chords like alt+f1 and clicks at the cursor are skipped), EVE may ignore posted input entirely, and nothing is ever sent if 0 or 2+ windows match. Test with 'run.bat --test-background'. See README 'Two clients on one PC'.

spots._note: Named screen spots, saved as [left, top, right, bottom] by 'run.bat --calibrate' (drag a box); a command using one does ONE click at the box centre. null = not set: commands using it are skipped until you calibrate (or say 'set way point spot' - two words because the speech model doesn't know 'waypoint'). next_waypoint = the next waypoint/gate row, e.g. top of your Overview sorted for it, or the route panel.

color_targets._README: Screen colour targets for the opt-in 'gate' (see settings.allow_screen_read). Set up in the app: Next gate tab.

next_gate._note: Opt-in screen reading for 'gate'. Set the Overview area and pick the yellow colour in the app (Next gate tab) before turning it on.

combat_weapons._note: PvP / PvE. High slots F1-F8 = EVE default. Rename phrases to what's fitted, e.g. 'guns' -> F1.

combat_mid_slots._note: Mid slots = Alt+F1..F8 by default. Typical: prop mod, point, web, shield booster. Rename to match your fit.

combat_low_slots._note: Low slots = Ctrl+F1..F8 by default (repairers, hardeners).

combat_targeting._note: 'lock' holds Ctrl down until YOU click the thing to lock (EVE's default Ctrl+click), max 10 s. One key input + your own click.

mouse._note: ONE single click at the CURRENT cursor position. No double clicks, no modifier+click (1:1 rule).

drones._note: Drone defaults: Launch Shift+F, Engage F, Return to bay Shift+R. Verify under Shortcuts > Drones.

navigation._note: EVE's default movement actions are HOLD-the-key-then-click (hold Q + click = approach, W = orbit, E = keep at range, A = align, S = warp to, D = jump/dock, Ctrl = lock). So these default to 'hold_until': 'click': the tool holds ONE key down, YOU click the target (in space or the Overview), and the key is let go right after your click (or after 10 s, or when you say 'release'). The tool never clicks. If something is already selected and you just want a tap (Selected Item panel keys), edit the command > When said: Tap. Per your spec warp = D; EVE's own default is S = Warp To and D = Jump/Dock - check Esc > Shortcuts. dock/jump are empty because D is used for warp here.

mining._note: Mining lasers/strip miners are just high slots - set them to whichever F-key they're in. Survey scanner is usually a mid slot.

exploration_scanning._note: V = run directional scan; Alt+D = D-Scan window; Alt+P = Probe Scanner window. Verify.

windows_travel._note: F10 = World Map (default). Add others (inventory, market, journal) yourself from Esc > Shortcuts - we didn't include ones we weren't sure of.
windows_travel._note_select_next: 'select next' = ONE left click on the saved next_waypoint spot (selects it). Then say 'warp' (or your jump key phrase) as a separate command. Set the spot once with 'run.bat --calibrate'. Until then it's skipped with a warning. Re-calibrate if that row/panel moves.
windows_travel._note_gate: 'gate' (also 'select next gate' / 'next gate' / 'select gate') = ONE left click on the YELLOW next-gate row of your Overview, found on screen when you say it. OPT-IN (settings.allow_screen_read, off by default) and needs setup in the app (Next gate tab). If no yellow row is found, or two far apart, it clicks NOTHING. Say 'warp gate' (in one breath or with a pause): 'warp' holds D, 'gate' clicks the gate while D is down, then D is let go.

custom_set_your_own._note: EVE has these actions but default keys vary / we're not sure - bind a single key or chord in Esc > Shortcuts, then fill it in. Entries with an empty key are skipped.

saved_positions_fragile._note: DISABLED EXAMPLE of a command with its OWN saved spot (ONE click there). Set enabled = true, then 'run.bat --calibrate "click undock"' to drag a box over the button (or type a point from 'run.bat --where' as "mouse_at": [x, y]). Breaks if the EVE window/UI moves.

setup._note: Setup phrases - they send NO game input. 'set way point spot' re-drags the next-waypoint box (Esc cancels). 'teach command' opens the app's Teach window. Set enabled to false if they ever trigger by accident.
setup._note_release: 'release' / 'let go' lets go of a held key right away - it's the keyUp of that same one input, not a new one.

background_test._note: Harmless check for background_window mode: toggles the map (F10) on the target client. Change the key if you've rebound the map.
